channel.title: Canopticon — Habits & maintenance
channel.description: Questions researched in depth, and articles written from what the research found.

item.title: Fixed times versus flexible routines in exercise habits: what the paid-to-exercise trials found
item.dc:creator: Chris Telford
item.description: Paid to exercise at a set time, people did less than those paid to exercise whenever they liked — and quit faster afterwards. What helps is a fixed start and an open workout.

item.title: Self-extinguishing maintenance: treatments that stop because they are working, and the relapse that follows
item.dc:creator: Chris Telford
item.description: Some problems only stay fixed while you keep treating them — a gap between two teeth, toes pressed too tight. The treatment works, the problem vanishes, it looks cured, you stop, and it comes back. This research named the cycle and the mistake behind it.

item.title: Time Blindness, Task-Hopping, and Why a Delivery Queue Feels Easy
